auth.description:
To obtain your PredictLeads tokens, follow these steps:

    1. Have a PredictLeads account - Create a new user here: https://predictleads.com/sign_up.
    2. Go to: https://predictleads.com/subscriptions.
    3. In the subscription page, locate the API Key and Tokens section where you can also find the usage.

apiKey.description: The key of the Predict Leads account.

apiToken.description: The token of the Predict Leads account.

minMaxSizes.description: A min-max size range. Examples: "11-50"". For now, only single range is supported.

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Discovers companies in the PredictLeads database filtered by location and employee headcount range (e.g. "11-50"). Use to prospect or build a target-account list when you do not yet know specific company domains; both location and size range are required. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

predict-leads_find_company_by_domain.name: predict-leads_find_company_by_domain
predict-leads_find_company_by_domain.description: Retrieves a company by its domain.

domain.description: The domain of the company to find.

aiMetadata.description: Looks up a single company profile in PredictLeads by its web domain (e.g. "stripe.com"). Use when you already know the domain and want that company's details. Read-only and idempotent.

predict-leads_find_job_openings.name: predict-leads_find_job_openings
predict-leads_find_job_openings.description: Retrieves a list of job openings

onet_codes.description: O*NET codes to filter by, such as "17-2071.00" for "Electrical Engineers" or "15-1254.00" for "Web Developers". For full list of possible codes see: https://www.onetonline.org/find/all

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Discovers job openings across all companies in PredictLeads, optionally filtered by O*NET occupation codes (e.g. "15-1254.00" for Web Developers). Use to find hiring activity for specific roles without targeting a particular company; for one known company's postings use the company job-openings action instead. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

predict-leads_find_company_job_openings.name: predict-leads_find_company_job_openings
predict-leads_find_company_job_openings.description: Retrieves job openings by company domain.

active_only.description: Set to true if you'd like to receive JobOpenings that are not closed, have last_seen_at more recent than 5 days and were found in the last year

not_closed.description: Similar to active_only, but without considering last_seen_at timestamp.

first_seen_at_from.description: Only return data first seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

first_seen_at_until.description: Only return data first seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

last_seen_at_from.description: Only return data last seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

last_seen_at_until.description: Only return data last seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

with_description_only.description: Only return JobOpenings that have description

with_location_only.description: Only return JobOpenings that have location

categories.description: Select categories to filter job openings

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Lists a specific company's job openings in PredictLeads, keyed by its domain. Optional filters narrow results to active or not-yet-closed postings, date windows, openings that have a description or location, and job categories. Use to gauge a known company's hiring activity as a buying or growth signal; requires the company domain. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

predict-leads_get_a_job_opening_by_id.name: predict-leads_get_a_job_opening_by_id
predict-leads_get_a_job_opening_by_id.description: Retrieves a single job opening by ID.

jobOpeningId.description: The ID of the job opening to retrieve.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of one job opening in PredictLeads by its job opening ID. Use when you already have an opening ID (e.g. from a list/discover call) and want its complete record. Read-only and idempotent.

predict-leads_find_technologies_by_domai.name: predict-leads_find_technologies_by_domain
predict-leads_find_technologies_by_domai.description: Retrieve technologies used by specific company

domain.description: The domain of the company to find.

first_seen_at_from.description: Only return data first seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

first_seen_at_until.description: Only return data first seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

last_seen_at_from.description: Only return data last seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

last_seen_at_until.description: Only return data last seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Lists the technologies (technology detections) that a specific company uses, keyed by its domain in PredictLeads. Optional first/last-seen date filters scope detections to a time window. Use for technographic profiling of a known company; requires the company domain. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

predict-leads_find_companies_by_technolo.name: predict-leads_find_companies_by_technology_id
predict-leads_find_companies_by_technolo.description: Retrieves company using specific technology ID

id.description: The ID of the technology to find.

first_seen_at_from.description: Only return data first seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

first_seen_at_until.description: Only return data first seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

last_seen_at_from.description: Only return data last seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

last_seen_at_until.description: Only return data last seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Discovers companies that use a given technology, keyed by that technology's ID in PredictLeads. Optional first/last-seen date filters scope results to a time window. Use to build a target list of companies on a specific tool/stack; requires the technology ID (not a name). Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

predict-leads_find_news_by_domain.name: predict-leads_find_news_by_domain
predict-leads_find_news_by_domain.description: Retrieves news events by company domain

domain.description: The domain of the company to find.

found_at_from.description: Only return data first seen after given date . Example 2024-09-25

found_at_until.description: Only return data first seen before given date . Example 2024-09-25

categories.description: The categories of news to find.

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Lists news events (buying/intent signals such as funding, acquisitions, leadership changes, office expansions, product launches) for a specific company, keyed by its domain in PredictLeads. Optional found-at date range and event categories narrow the results. Use to surface recent triggers for a known company; requires the company domain. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

predict-leads_find_news_event_by_id.name: predict-leads_find_news_event_by_id
predict-leads_find_news_event_by_id.description: Retrieves a single news event by ID.

id.description: The ID of the news event to find.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves the full details of one news event in PredictLeads by its event ID. Use when you already have a news event ID (e.g. from a list call) and want its complete record. Read-only and idempotent.

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Lists all portfolio-company connections available to the authenticated PredictLeads account, across companies (not scoped to a single domain). Use to retrieve the full connection set rather than one company's connections. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.

limit.description: Limit the number of shown items per page. Max 1000.

aiMetadata.description: Lists a company's business connections (related/linked companies) in PredictLeads, keyed by its domain. Use to map a known company's relationship graph; requires the company domain. Read-only and idempotent; supports pagination.
